note: Code points and strings in hex. keys: identityKey of every code point whose key is neither itself nor empty (cp:k1,k2,…; A-B:T maps A+i to T+i, and A-B/2:T maps A+2i to T+2i). removed: the code points whose key is empty. composites: the code points NFC composes from their NFD, Hangul syllables aside. combiningClasses: [first, last, c]: the code points NFD leaves alone whose canonical combining class is nonzero and the same as c's. caseIgnorable and casedNotIgnorable: the classes toLowerCase's Final_Sigma rule reads. strings: [input, identityKey]. nfc: [input, NFC].
